ValidationRule.description: Once approved, the code, account and parent are frozen and dates may only be tightened (end earlier, start later).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( ISNEW(), FALSE, AND( PRIORVALUE(Is_Approved__c), OR( ISCHANGED(Code__c), ISCHANGED(Account__c), ISCHANGED(Parent_Project__c), AND(ISCHANGED(End_Date__c), End_Date__c > PRIORVALUE(End_Date__c)), AND(ISCHANGED(Start_Date__c), Start_Date__c < PRIORVALUE(Start_Date__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approved projects have locked identity fields and may only tighten dates.
